title: Generate the European task-345 bank plan
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Add rom-data plan-tilemap-bank to follow the 23 source-backed selectors into the full type-3 transfer bank and emit a standard ownership plan for the exact European ROM. Share the bounded LZ77 token parser to find encoded input lengths without decoding payloads.
validation: Windows build wxkz7e3r passed. Wine xkte2drk matches E466 for every selector and role group and all tested E301 owner splits, rejects a same-size synthetic image, passes four focused LZ77 tests and drains Wine. Recovery kppbgu_4 confirms the logs and all 23 protected inputs after the scratch guard retained the synthetic file.
limitations: The CLI produces source metadata only. Managed reads, raw/managed equivalence, other banks, native Linux, USA and native Windows remain open.
